After removing only the new four-line C clause and reversing the literal name, the entire private proposition is exactly the compiled parent's proposition. The same six public analytic callers and twelve common witnesses S,e,U,T,Gamma,q,GammaP0,Inv,A0,B0,V0,R are retained. Witnesses precede arbitrary globally centered f; fP and gP are local to each f. There is no proof provider, hidden public certificate, mean_g caller, onto V premise, positive-rank condition, strict alpha eta endpoint, extra smoothness, rho/omega assumption or sharp-energy68 dependency.

Definitions retain actual semantics. U is the same AE pullback by F(x,y)=(x,2x-y); it is not an arbitrary coefficient transform. P is the actual conditional expectation given Y. HP0 is the zero-mean subspace of the conditional macroscopic space, while Hperp is all ker P. R is the same canonical residual map. D=R U inclusion and V0*D=-A0 V0* remain full-domain identities on Hperp, without restricting to ran V0. V0 is an isometric embedding and can fail to be onto; only e is onto its exact conditional subspace.

For actual centered f, fP is its conditional expectation, fV=V0*Rf, g=U(Pf-(f-Pf)), gP is the actual conditional expectation of that same g, and gV=V0*Rg. The parent internally proves mean(g)=0 using the reflection-preserved augmentation law and integral preservation by conditional expectation (parent70 lines312-330 and412-417). Current71 retains this conclusion through the exact parent global implication and does not make it a caller premise. Both actual output components exist under these semantics before the rotation equations are applied. The old pair-energy, norm budget, ambient adjoint, root, inverse, probability and kernel conclusions remain intact.

B20 is exact: C(u,v)=(||u||^2-||v||^2)/2-inner(A0(Inv u),v) for u,v in the SAME HP0, with the SAME centered inverse. Its primary math id is A2.E20.m1, full RAW[821632,823578), SHA f1a5862a52d5ebf635a6a45763a8eb1a379cfe8e2326d31e0e698e357d3b2b5f. The inverse is never extended across constants. The added proof expands the source's coefficient calculation internally. Lines326-341 derive ||A0u||^2+||Gamma0u||^2=||u||^2 and the commuting mixed-inner identity. Lines342-361 set the local corrector operator K=A0 Inv and derive KGamma0=Gamma0K=A0 and KA0=A0K from the SAME two-sided inverse and commutation. This local K is explicitly scoped and is not the paper's actual Markov transition K. Lines362-382 derive A0 K A0 u+Gamma0 A0 u=Ku and then its real inner-product form. Lines383-395 supply both diagonal identities and real symmetry. All these are internally derived proof ingredients, not public caller binders or an invented sharp-energy parent.

I independently checked the signs of the corrector expansion. Put X=||A0u||^2,Y=||Gamma0u||^2,Z=||A0v||^2,W=||Gamma0v||^2,t=inner(A0u,Gamma0v),r=inner(Ku,v). For u'=A0u-Gamma0v and v'=Gamma0u+A0v, the norm squares are X+W-2t and Y+Z+2t. The inner cross term is inner(Ku',v')=X-Z+r-2t by the diagonal and mixed identities. Consequently C(u',v')=(-X-Y+Z+W)/2-r, and subtracting C(u,v) gives -||u||^2+||v||^2. Lines396-402 implement precisely these expansions and use only the already proved energy/mixed identities for the concluding scalar algebra. There is no omitted gamma multiplier, sign reversal, surrogate coefficient theorem or stronger domain assumption.

Lines403-440 apply that arbitrary-centered-vector ingredient to the actual produced fP,fV and gP,gV. The two-argument congruence of C uses the already proved actual rotation equations; fV and gV remain the actual adjoints of Rf and Rg. The legal rank-zero and alpha eta=1 cases remain permitted: the new proof uses Hilbert/operator algebra on possibly zero HP0 and introduces no nonzero-dimensional or strict-gap-to-one premise.
